decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - No work shall start on site without prior written notification of the start to the London Division of the Historic Buildings and Monuments Commission, quoting reference date _________.
Condition : 3 - A schedule for all new windows, stone sills, doors and architraves (and any repair works to existing) at scale 1:5 (or as appropriate) be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Authority in consultation with English Heritage before the commence of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 4 - A method statement for all repair and restoration works (including any works to the floors, joists, skirting, fireplaces, panelling and architrave) at ground and first floor level shall be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Authority in consultation with English Heritage before the commence of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 5 - Sample panels of brickwork showing the proposed colour, texture, face-bond and pointing (including brick arches) shall be provided on site and approved by the Local Planning Authority in consultation with English Heritage before the works are commenced and the sample panels shall be retained on site until the work is completed and has been approved.

Condition : 6 - A sample roof slate showing the proposed colour and texture shall be provided on site and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority in consultation with English Heritage before the commence of works.

Condition : 7 - The proposed window detail at third floor level (drawing 167/2 B) is considered unsatisfactory in the form shown on the drawings submitted to date and this aspect of the scheme shall be omitted.

Condition : 8 - No plumbing or pipes, other than rainwater pipes, shall be fixed on the external faces of the building unless shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 9 - The rooflight shall be a flush conservation type.
Condition : 10 - The door between the utility and the dining room shall be fixed shut and carefully boarded over.  Detailed drawings at scale 1:5 shall be submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a two storey rear extension and installation of a side window at ground floor level and a first floor window to rear of dwellinghouse.
